name: Advanced Render Auditor
description: Site-wide render tree profiler for local development. Traces render and query times, collects bubbled cache metadata, and annotates slow elements.
project_description: Advanced Render Auditor (ARA) is a site-wide render tree profiler for local Drupal development. It decorates the core renderer service and records one entry per rendered element — render time, database queries run during that element, and its bubbled cache keys/tags/contexts — building a floating results panel at the bottom of every page with a summary bar, color-coded per-element rows, inline cache-metadata inspection, and click-through from an inherited tag/context to the element that originated it. It can also prepend a small severity-colored timing badge to each rendered element on the page (blocks and BigPipe-streamed content included). Profiling runs only when the config switch is on AND the current user holds the 'use ara profiler' permission; it is skipped on admin routes and short-circuits with a single boolean check otherwise. A runtime requirements check warns on the Status Report whenever the profiler is left enabled, since it adds significant overhead to every render call and is intended for local development only.
